SELECT a.id,a.target_type,a.target_id,a.type,a.kind,a.registered,a.registered_by,a.object_key,a.url, a.original_name,a.sort_order,a.content_type,a.size_bytes,a.width,a.height,a.duration_seconds, a.verified,a.retention,a.expires_at,a.deleted,a.created_at FROM media_attachment a WHERE a.registered=1 AND a.registered_by=#{actor} AND a.retention='FORMAL' AND a.deleted=0 AND a.target_type IS NULL AND a.target_id IS NULL AND (1=0
OR (COALESCE(a.kind,'')!='VIDEO' AND (a.object_key IS NULL OR a.object_key NOT LIKE 'article-resource/%'))
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attachment_link l WHERE l.attachment_id=a.id AND l.target_type IN #{type}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_upload_record u WHERE u.bound_attachment_id=a.id AND a.object_key=u.object_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND BINARY a.object_key=BINARY u.object_key AND u.user_id=#{actor} AND u.status=1 AND u.cleanup_started_at IS NULL AND u.target_type IN #{type}) )

SELECT l.attachment_id, l.target_type FROM event_attachment_link l WHERE l.attachment_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT a.id AS attachment_id, u.target_type FROM media_attachment a JOIN media_upload_record u ON a.id = u.bound_attachment_id AND a.object_key = u.object_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND BINARY a.object_key = BINARY u.object_key WHERE a.id IN #{id} AND a.registered = 1 AND a.registered_by = #{actor} AND u.user_id = #{actor} AND u.status IN (0, 1) AND u.cleanup_started_at IS NULL AND u.bound_target_id IS NULL AND u.target_type IN (2, 3, 7, 8)

mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.type, a.kind, a.registered, a.registered_by, a.object_key, a.url, a.original_name, l.display_order AS sort_order, a.created_at, a.content_type, a.size_bytes, a.width, a.height, a.duration_seconds, a.verified, a.retention, a.expires_at, a.deleted FROM event_attachment_link l JOIN media_attachment a ON a.id = l.attachment_id WHERE l.target_type = #{targetType} AND l.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY l.display_order, a.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM event_attachment_link WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_attachment_link (target_type, target_id, attachment_id, display_order) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{attachmentId}, #{displayOrder})
